messages:
maria-sec: Heads-up — after yesterday's RBAC refactor, we have a handful of SSO logins where eduPersonScopedAffiliation is missing and users are being assigned the 'guest' role via JIT. Hitting internal dashboards and CI access.

jonah-idp: ugh. do you have a sample assertion / log?

maria-sec: pasted from the auth service logs for user alice@example.com (sanitized):
```
SAML_ASSERTION user=alice@example.com issuer=okta org=example-corp
attributes: {
  eduPersonPrincipalName: "alice@example.com",
  displayName: "Alice L",
  # NOTE: eduPersonScopedAffiliation absent
}
mapped_role: "guest"  # defaulted in mapping because eduPersonScopedAffiliation missing
```

sara-ops: that's the mapping we turned on last week — we made eduPersonScopedAffiliation required-to-map because it was disambiguating student/staff/employee. looks like some IdPs (esp older edu integrations) don't send that attr.

kevin-platform: we get two problems: 1) role assignment wrong (security issue), 2) no audit event with the raw attrs to investigate. we should log raw SAML attrs (redacted) into the audit pipeline and encrypt with our KMS key.

jonah-idp: agreed on missing attrs. For Okta specifically, some orgs map `eduPersonScopedAffiliation` into `edu_affil` custom attr; mapping rules vary. quick mitigation: change the JIT mapping to fallback to `eduPersonPrincipalName` domain -> map to employee for @example-corp, and use group membership as secondary.

maria-sec: proposed quick patch (canary):
1) relax required flag on eduPersonScopedAffiliation mapping so it doesn't default to guest.
2) add fallback heuristics: if email domain in allowlist -> assign 'employee', else if groups contains 'staff' -> assign 'staff', else keep 'guest'.
3) emit audit event `sso_jit_role_assignment` with fields: subject, mapped_role, mapping_source: (affil|domain|group|default), and redacted_attrs hash. encrypted at rest with KMS key `audit/sso` (existing).

kevin-platform: fine, but two asks: (A) rolling change must be reversible (toggle via feature flag), (B) add an alert on rate of guest assignments per org > 1% of logins in 10m -> page on-call.

jonah-idp: I'll prepare the mapping patch. sample mapping snippet to apply in the IdP adapter: 
```
// pseudo-config
mappings:
  role:
    - source: eduPersonScopedAffiliation
      required: false   # previous was true
      map:
        staff: staff
        faculty: staff
        employee: employee
    - source: email_domain
      allowlist: ["example-corp", "example.com"]
      assign: employee
    - source: groups
      match: ['staff','engineering']
      assign: staff
    - source: default
      assign: guest
```

maria-sec: we'll need a quick audit PR to add `sso_jit_role_assignment` into the audit schema and include redacted SAML attrs (sha256) and KMS envelope metadata. can you own that, @sara-ops?

sara-ops: yes. I'll add the audit event and wire it to existing KMS key. also will add a note to rotate the key if we see any anomalies.

kevin-platform: prod rollout plan: canary on 2 orgs (one edu, one corp) for 30m, monitor guest->employee ratio, latency, and any auth failures. rollback flag ready. schedule the deploy at 16:00 UTC.

deploy-bot: deploy started: rollout-id=rl-2024-06-12-07, targets=[org-123, org-789], feature_flag=jit-role-fallback-v2

jonah-idp: deployed canary patch to org-123. logs show for org-123 guest assignments dropped from 3.1% -> 0.2% in first 10m. no auth failures.

maria-sec: good signal. keep monitoring for 1h then expand. also add a quick test to the SSO integration tests to explicitly assert mapping when eduPersonScopedAffiliation absent.

sara-ops: audit event PR up: https://git.internal/r/audit/PR/437 -> includes redacted_attrs sha256 and KMS envelope id.

kevin-platform: thanks. once 1h looks good, we'll roll to org-789 and then global. tagging incident: SSO-JIT-MAP-2024-06.

maria-sec: thanks team. follow-ups: add owner for long-term mapping doc (jonah), schedule KMS key rotation check (sara), and add alert threshold (kevin). :thumbsup:
